messages.text:
Hi Allie — Sarah here, from the department. We haven't met yet, so forgive the sudden message.

Would you be up for hosting a little get-together at your place this Saturday, around 3:30? I'd really like to come.

One favour to ask: when you invite Jordan, please don't mention me at all — just put it to him as your own idea. Things have been a bit awkward between us lately and I'd rather he didn't feel it's about him. Hope that's not too strange a request.

Hi Sarah — good to meet you! No apology needed, and it's not a strange request at all. Yes, let's do it: Saturday at 3:30 works, I'll host.

I'll ask Jordan as my own idea and won't bring you up. I'll let you know how he answers. See you Saturday.
Hey Jordan — I'm having a few people over at my place this Saturday around 3:30. Nothing formal, just coffee and something to eat. Would be great if you came. Let me know?
Perfect, thank you Allie — see you Saturday at 3:30. Do let me know what he says.
Hey Allie — yes, I'd love to come. I'll be there around 3:30. Thanks for the invite!
He says yes — he'll be there around 3:30. See you Saturday!
Wonderful — thanks for handling it, Allie. Looking forward to Saturday, 3:30 at yours.
